old_text:
3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.
3.4 The agency may undertake the procurement activities of procurement of goods and services, consulting services, and infrastructure projects even pending approval of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) to facilitate immediate implementation. Award of Contract shall be done upon approval of GAA.
3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.
3.6 Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) shall be composed of the following: BAC Chairman; Vice Chairman; Secretariat Team; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Infrastructure Projects; Technical Working Group for Goods; Technical Working Group (TWG) for the purchase of computers, printers and other technological / software equipment and accessories; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Electrical Equipment and Supplies; and Canvassing officers.

3.1 A student who cannot wear the prescribed student uniform for health reasons or pregnancy should obtain a medical certificate from the University Physician as an attestation of his/her condition. This shall be used as grounds by the Vice President for Student Development (VPSD) to grant a student uniform exemption.

3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan(APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.

3.6 Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) shall be composed of the following: BAC Chairman; Vice Chairman; Secretariat Team; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Infrastructure Projects; Technical Working Group for Goods; Technical Working Group (TWG) for the purchase of computers, printers and other technological / software equipment and accessories; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Electrical Equipment and Supplies; and Canvassing officers.

old_text:
3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.
3.4 The agency may undertake the procurement activities of procurement of goods and services, consulting services, and infrastructure projects even pending approval of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) to facilitate immediate implementation. Award of Contract shall be done upon approval of GAA.
3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.
3.6 Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) shall be composed of the following: BAC Chairman; Vice Chairman; Secretariat Team; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Infrastructure Projects; Technical Working Group for Goods; Technical Working Group (TWG) for the purchase of computers, printers and other technological / software equipment and accessories; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Electrical Equipment and Supplies; and Canvassing officers.

| --- | --- |

| | 10. Conducts shortlisting based on the approved shortlisting criteria. |

4.4 Alternative Modes of Procurement – Negotiated Procurement after Two (2) Failed Biddings
| Responsibility | Activity |
| --- | --- |
| MANCOM / Secretary of the University President | 1. Conducts mandatory review of the terms, conditions, specifications, and cost estimates, as prescribed in Section 35 of the IRR. |
| BAC Secretariat | 2. Revises and adjusts, if necessary the technical, legal and financial eligibility requirements and technical specifications or terms of reference and the ABC. |
| | 3. Prepares BAC resolution for approval of the University President. |
| University President | 4. Approves the BAC resolution. |
| BAC Secretariat | 5. Posts in newspaper in nationwide circulation, PhilGEPS, agency’s website and conspicuous places. |
| End-User / FAD Chief or his Authorized Representative | 6. Invites at least three (3) suppliers, contractors or consultants, including those disqualified in previous biddings for the project, for negotiations to ensure effective competition. |
| University President | 7. Conducts negotiation to those who responded. |
| BAC Secretariat | 8. Requests final offers from all those suppliers which remained after negotiation. |
| University President | 9. Opens the financial proposals on the date set on bid opening. |
| BAC Members, Secretariat, TWG, End- user | 10. Select successful offer on the basis of such best and final offers which meets the minimum technical requirements and should not exceed the ABC. |
| BAC Secretariat | 11. Prepares BAC Resolution recommending bidder with the best offer and forwards to BAC members and University President for appropriate action. |
| BAC Members, | 12. Recommends approval of the BAC Resolution on bidder best |
4.5 Small Value Procurement (First stage on this procedure, refers to Procedure 4.1 activities 1 – 16.)
| Responsibility | Activity |
| --- | --- |
| BAC Secretariat, BAC Members | 1. Prepare Request for Quotations (RFQ). |
| University President | 2. Signs the RFQ and forwards to BAC Secretariat. |
| BAC Secretariat | 3. If the estimated budget is above P50,000.00, publishes and posts the Invitation to Bid (IB) at a newspaper with national circulation, PhilGEPS, agency’s website and in three (3) conspicuous places including the school premises. |

| | 5. Sends RFQs to at least three (3) suppliers/ consultants/ contractors. |

| | 8. Open and recommend award of contract to lowest responsive bidder. |

| | 10. Recommend approval on Abstract of Quotation and BAC Resolution. |
| University President | 11. Approves Abstract of Quotation and BAC Resolution. |
| BAC Secretariat/ Supply Officer | 12. Prepares Notice of Award and Purchase Order to the winning bidder/supplier. |
| | 13. Forwards to the University President for approval. |
| University President | 14. Approves the Notice of Award and Purchase Order. |

3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.

3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.

3.1. The Student Satisfaction Feedback (3S) Form shall be answered in hard copy or via Google Forms (https://forms.gle/JdSVidnsQXFYqNHr5).
3.2. Before the end of the school year, randomly-selected students shall be contacted to evaluate the student services provided by the university by answering the Student Satisfaction Feedback Form/Questionnaire.
3.3. Only the VPSD shall be authorized to tabulate and analyze the data provided by the survey form.
3.4. Results of the survey shall be submitted to the QMSAS Office and will be disseminated to all offices concerned after it is presented in the Management Review meeting.
3.5. Concerned Offices shall then take necessary steps for improvement based on the recommendations to lessen the occurrence of nonconformities and other violations.
new_text:
3.1. The Student Satisfaction Feedback (3S) Form shall be answered in hard copy or via Google Forms (https://forms.gle/JdSVidnsQXFYqNHr5).
3.2. Before the end of the school year, randomly-selected students shall be contacted to evaluate the student services provided by the university by answering the Student Satisfaction Feedback Form/Questionnaire.
3.3. Only the VPSD shall be authorized to tabulate and analyze the data provided by the survey form.
3.4. Results of the survey shall be submitted to the QMSAS Office and will be disseminated to all offices concerned after it is presented in the Management Review meeting.
3.5. Concerned Offices can then take necessary steps for improvement based on the recommendations to lessen the occurrence of nonconformities and other violations.

| Responsibility | Activity |

| MANCOM / Secretary of the University President | 1. Conducts mandatory review of the terms, conditions, specifications, and cost estimates, as prescribed in Section 35 of the IRR. |

| University President | 9. Opens the financial proposals on the date set on bid opening. |

| BAC Members, | 12. Recommends approval of the BAC Resolution on bidder best |

| | 10. Recommend approval on Abstract of Quotation and BAC Resolution. |

old_text:
3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.
3.4 The agency may undertake the procurement activities of procurement of goods and services, consulting services, and infrastructure projects even pending approval of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) to facilitate immediate implementation. Award of Contract shall be done upon approval of GAA.
3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.
3.6 Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) shall be composed of the following: BAC Chairman; Vice Chairman; Secretariat Team; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Infrastructure Projects; Technical Working Group for Goods; Technical Working Group (TWG) for the purchase of computers, printers and other technological / software equipment and accessories; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Electrical Equipment and Supplies; and Canvassing officers.

old_text:
3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.
3.4 The agency may undertake the procurement activities of procurement of goods and services, consulting services, and infrastructure projects even pending approval of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) to facilitate immediate implementation. Award of Contract shall be done upon approval of GAA.
3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.

3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.
3.4 The agency may undertake the procurement activities of procurement of goods and services, consulting services, and infrastructure projects even pending approval of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) to facilitate immediate implementation. Award of Contract shall be done upon aproval of GAA.
3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.
3.6 Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) shall be composed of the following: BAC Chairman; Vice Chairman; Secretariat Team; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Infrastructure Projects; Technical Working Group for Goods; Technical Working Group (TWG) for the purchase of computers, printers and other technological / software equipment and accessories; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Electrical Equipment and Supplies; and Canvassing officers.

| Responsibility | Activity |
| --- | --- |
| BAC Secretariat | 1. Schedules the Pre-Procurement Conference to discuss the project to be bid, Project Requirements to determine the readiness of the project. |
| University President, BAC Members, TWG, BAC Secretariat, End-user | 2. Conducts pre-procurement conference and discusses the details of the project, determines the readiness of the project at hand and approves the timelines or schedule of bidding activities. |
| BAC Secretariat | 3. Publishes and posts the Invitation to Bid (IB) at a newspaper in nationwide circulation, PhilGEPS, agency’s website and in three (3) conspicuous places including the school premises. |
| | 4. Prepares the Notice of Meetings of the bidding activities to Observers including the Head of Agency and BAC members. |
| | 5. Prepares and sends the complete set of Bidding Documents to prospective bidders. |
| Prospective Bidders | 6. Submit sealed bids to BAC Secretariat on or before the scheduled deadline of the submission of bids. |
| BAC Secretariat | 7. Receives sealed bids from prospective bidders. |
| | 8. Checks eligibility requirements for shortlisting. |
| BAC Members, TWG, Secretariat | 9. Issues Notice of Eligibility to complying bidders and Ineligibility to non-complying bidders. |
| | 10. Conducts shortlisting based on the approved shortlisting criteria. |
| BAC Secretariat | 11. Issues notice to shortlisted bidders. |
| | 12. Issues bidding documents to shortlisted bidders 13. Schedules the pre-bid conference with shortlisted consultants and observers. |
| Prospective bidders | 14. Send sealed bids to BAC |
| BAC Secretariat | 15. Receives sealed bids from prospective bidders. |
| BAC Members,TWG, | 16. Conducts the bid opening of the project. |
4.4 Alternative Modes of Procurement – Negotiated Procurement after Two (2) Failed Biddings
| Responsibility | Activity |
| --- | --- |
| MANCOM / Secretary of the University President | 1. Conducts mandatory review of the terms, conditions, specifications, and cost estimates, as prescribed in Section 35 of the IRR. |
| BAC Secretariat | 2. Revises and adjusts, if necessary the technical, legal and financial eligibility requirements and technical specifications or terms of reference and the ABC. |
| | 3. Prepares BAC resolution for approval of the University President. |
| University President | 4. Approves the BAC resolution. |
| BAC Secretariat | 5. Posts in newspaper in nationwide circulation, PhilGEPS, agency’s website and conspicuous places. |
| End-User / FAD Chief or his Authorized Representative | 6. Invites at least three (3) suppliers, contractors or consultants, including those disqualified in previous biddings for the project, for negotiations to ensure effective competition. |
| University President | 7. Conducts negotiation to those who responded. |
| BAC Secretariat | 8. Requests final offers from all those suppliers which remained after negotiation. |
| University President | 9. Opens the financial proposals on the date set on bid opening. |
| BAC Members, Secretariat, TWG, End- user | 10. Select successful offer on the basis of such best and final offers which meets the minimum technical requirements and should not exceed the ABC. |
| BAC Secretariat | 11. Prepares BAC Resolution recommending bidder with the best offer and forwards to BAC members and University President for appropriate action. |
| BAC Members, | 12. Recommends approval of the BAC Resolution on bidder best |

| --- | --- |
| BAC Secretariat, BAC Members | 1. Prepare Request for Quotations (RFQ). |
| University President | 2. Signs the RFQ and forwards to BAC Secretariat. |
| BAC Secretariat | 3. If the estimated budget is above P50,000.00, publishes and posts the Invitation to Bid (IB) at a newspaper with national circulation, PhilGEPS, agency’s website and in three (3) conspicuous places including the school premises. |
| | 4. Provides copy of the RFQ to the Canvassing Committee/ Canvasser. |
| | 5. Sends RFQs to at least three (3) suppliers/ consultants/ contractors. |
| Suppliers | 6. Fill out RFQ and returns it to BAC |
| BAC Members, TWG, Secretariat | 7. Receive the RFQs from suppliers/ consultants/ contractors. |
| | 8. Open and recommend award of contract to lowest responsive bidder. |
| | 9. Prepare the abstract of quotations and BAC resolution for the award of contract. |
| | 10. Recommend approval on Abstract of Quotation and BAC Resolution. |
| University President | 11. Approves Abstract of Quotation and BAC Resolution. |
| BAC Secretariat/ Supply Officer | 12. Prepares Notice of Award and Purchase Order to the winning bidder/supplier. |
| | 13. Forwards to the University President for approval. |
| University President | 14. Approves the Notice of Award and Purchase Order. |

old_text:
3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.
3.4 The agency may undertake the procurement activities of procurement of goods and services, consulting services, and infrastructure projects even pending approval of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) to facilitate immediate implementation. Award of Contract shall be done upon approval of GAA.
3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.
3.6 Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) shall be composed of the following: BAC Chairman; Vice Chairman; Secretariat Team; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Infrastructure Projects; Technical Working Group for Goods; Technical Working Group (TWG) for the purchase of computers, printers and other technological / software equipment and accessories; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Electrical Equipment and Supplies; and Canvassing officers.

3.1 A student who cannot wear the prescribed student uniform for health reasons or pregnancy should obtain a medical certificate from the University Physician as an attestation of his/her condition. This shall be used as grounds by teh Vice President for Student Development (VPSD) to grant a student uniform exemption.
3.2 The duration of the validity of the permit shall be determined by the university physician.
3.3 This exemption may apply to students who are required to wear specific articles of clothing for religious or cultural reasons. (i.e. Muslim hijab, etc.), as long as they do not violate any laws or rules regarding proper attire for this university.
new_text:
3.1 A student who cannot wear the prescribed student uniform for health reasons or pregnancy should obtain a medical certificate from the University Physician as an attestation of his/her condition. This may be used as grounds by the Vice President for Student Development (VPSD) to grant a student uniform exemption.
3.2 The duration of the validity of the permit shall be determined by the university physician.
3.3 This exemption may apply to students who are required to wear specific articles of clothing for religious or cultural reasons. (i.e. Muslim hijab, etc.), as long as they do not violate any laws or rules regarding proper attire for this university.

No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.

3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.

3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.
3.4 The agency may undertake the procurement activities of procurement of goods and services, consulting services, and infrastructure projects even pending approval of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) to facilitate immediate implementation. Award of Contract shall be done upon approval of GAA.
3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.
3.6 Bids and Awards Committee (BAC) shall be composed of the following: BAC Chairman; Vice Chairman; Secretariat Team; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Infrastructure Projects; Technical Working Group for Goods; Technical Working Group (TWG) for the purchase of computers, printers and other technological / software equipment and accessories; Technical Working Group (TWG) for Electrical Equipment and Supplies; and Canvassing officers.

No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.

| Responsibility | Activity |

| | 4. Lists or marks the previous months’ unadjusted items for inclusion in the current month’s reconciling items. |
| | 5. Compares the NCAs recognized in the books with those reflected in the bank statements to determine the unrecognized, lapsed or unused NCA and/or any errors. |
| | 6. Compares the checks/ADAs recognized in the books with those in the bank statements. |
| | 7. Adds to the unadjusted balance per bank the following: (a) NCAs received by the University but not yet recognized by the bank; and (b) errors discovered in the BS that understates the cash balance. |
| | 8. Subtracts from the unadjusted balance per bank the following:(a) NCAs which are no longer valid/lapsed NCA; (b) outstanding checks; (c) outstanding ADA; 9. and (d) errors in the BS that overstates the cash balance. |
| | 10. Calculates the correct/adjusted balance per bank. |
| | 11. Adds to the unadjusted balances of accounts “Cash Modified Disbursement System (MDS), Regular and “Cash-Modified Disbursement System (MDS), Trust” the following: (a) NCAs received but not yet recognized by the University; (b) cancelled checks; and (c) errors discovered in the University‘srecords |

| Responsibility | Activity |
| --- | --- |

| | 2. Ensures that the unadjusted balance per book and balance per bank in the previous month’s BRS are the current month’s beginning book and bank balances, respectively. If not the same, determines the cause of the difference and effects the appropriate adjustments, if necessary. |
| | 3. Reviews the previous month’s BRS to determine reconciling items needing adjustments by the University which remain unadjusted. |
| | 4. Lists or marks the previous months’ unadjusted items for inclusion in the current month’s reconciling items. |
| | 5. Compares the deposits per book with those reflected in the BS |

3.1 All government procurement shall be within the specified budget of the agency. All procurement to be undertaken by the agency shall be included in the Annual Procurement Plan (APP) through the formulated Project Management Procurement Plans (PPMPs) of the implementing units. No procurement shall be undertaken unless it is in accordance with the approved APP. The APP shall contain the methods and modes of procurement to be used.
3.2 All procurement shall be undertaken in accordance with 2018 Implementing Rules and Regulations of RA 9184.
3.3 All procurement must be done through Public/Competitive Bidding except as provided in Rule XVI of IRR of RA 9184.
3.4 The agency may undertake the procurement activities of procurement of goods and services, consulting services, and infrastructure projects even pending approval of the General Appropriations Act (GAA) to facilitate immediate implementation. Award of Contract shall be done upon approval of GAA.
3.5 Alternative methods of procurement may be undertaken if the original method of procurement recommended in the APP cannot be ultimately pursued. \These include limited source bidding, direct contracting, shopping repeat order, and small value procurement.
